resources.string: Build a study routine around focused flashcards, active recall, and steady progress.
• Keep every topic in one focused study space
• Study offline whenever you have a few minutes
• Learn at your own pace without distractions
Create subjects, write your own cards, or import a prepared Word document.
• Add questions, answers, comments, and difficulty
• Import multiple cards from a DOCX file
Think through each question, reveal the answer, and review cards when they are due.
• Tap Show Answer when you are ready
• Use review ratings to guide future practice
• Open Due Today for your daily review queue
Use tests, goals, streaks, and statistics to understand your progress over time.
• Keep a daily goal and study streak
Start with Subjects to create a deck, All Cards to search everything, or Due Today for scheduled reviews. Import Word adds cards in bulk.
The goal and streak cards track your study habit. Test Mode checks your recall, History keeps results, Statistics shows progress, and Settings contains reminders and backups.
Subjects organize related flashcards. Use the add button to create one, search by name, tap a subject to study it, or use its controls to edit or delete it.
Search questions, answers, comments, and subjects from one place. Use Filter to narrow the list, then tap any result to open that card.
Read the question and think before tapping Show Answer. Use Previous and Next to move through the deck.
After revealing the answer, rate your recall with Again, Hard, Good, or Easy so the card can be scheduled again. You can also edit, delete, change difficulty, or add a personal comment.
This session contains cards scheduled for review now. Reveal each answer and rate your recall to choose when the card should appear again.
Review the detected cards, inspect any format errors, choose a destination subject, and then confirm the import. You can also create a subject here.
Write every card as a ques entry followed by an ans entry, with the content inside quotation marks. Copy the example shown here when preparing a DOCX file.
Choose a subject, duration, one or more difficulty levels, and the number of cards. The timer begins only after you tap Start Test.
Reveal the answer, mark your response Correct or Incorrect, and continue. You may skip a question, and the timer ends the test automatically when it reaches zero.
Review the score and every response. Review Mistakes starts a focused follow-up session, while Save Permanently keeps this result outside the recent-history limit.
Recent Tests keeps the latest five ordinary results. Permanently Saved Tests remain until you delete them. Tap View Details to inspect the original questions and responses.
This screen shows the saved test snapshot, including correct, incorrect, and unanswered questions. Use Review Mistakes to practice missed cards again.
This screen summarizes today’s target and your all-time study progress. Changing the goal on Home keeps the cards you have already studied today.
A streak grows when you complete meaningful study activity on consecutive days. Current and longest streaks are calculated from your saved study history.
See how many cards are learning, young, or mature and review your saved-test accuracy. These values update as you study and complete tests.
Turn on an optional daily reminder and choose its time. Notification permission is requested only when you enable reminders.
Export cards as CSV, create or restore a full JSON backup, or clear app data. Clear All is permanent, so keep a backup if you may need the data later.
